src='''def transform(grid):
    # Move every non-background cell down by one row, preserving its column.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    h = len(grid)
    w = max(len(row) for row in grid)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != bg:
                out[r + 1][c] = value
    return out
'''
